subject: Private deployment commercial cadence: fee split & evaluation ramp
messages:
From: Emma Lowe <emma@orchid-cloud.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Chen <mchen@orchid-cloud.com>, procurement@orchid-cloud.com
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment evaluation

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — we left encouraged by the latency numbers and the ability to run inside our VPC. As we discussed, Orchid Cloud is evaluating a Private (VPC) deployment for our customer-facing AI features. To move to an executive procurement review we need: a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones tied to commercial triggers (pricing/commits/ramp), a draft SOW, and clarification on how the platform fee is applied for on-prem/private installs.

Key constraints from our side:
- We need an evaluation window of 8–10 weeks with a clear path to a paid reserved commitment if KPIs are met.
- Procurement prefers split payment options or amortized platform fees to ease budget phasing.
- SOC 2 evidence and a short list of required customer responsibilities for the private package.

Can you share a MAP and a sample payment schedule the vendor would accept (we're trying to model a ramp where committed GPU hours increase over the first 6 months)? Also loop in someone on legal/pricing so we can sanity-check platform fee treatment.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that's easier.

— Emma
Product Ops, Orchid Cloud

Attachments: none in this message
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lowe <emma@orchid-cloud.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment evaluation — MAP & payment approach

Emma — great to hear; appreciate the clarity on procurement needs. Drafting a short MAP and payment cadence for you — attaching Orchid_MAP_v2.xlsx and a short SOW draft. Top-level approach:

1) Evaluation phase (8 weeks)
   - Access: Private VPC with test and staging clusters
   - Success criteria: 99th-percentile latency < 150ms for 1k qps simulation, inference accuracy regression < 2% vs baseline prompts
   - Cost: evaluation usage billed at hosted eval rate, Redwood provides up to $25k in credits against first-year commits if KPIs met

2) Post-eval staged commitment (month 1–3):
   - Initial reserved commit: 3-month starter commit equal to 30% of expected steady-state GPU hours
   - Platform fee: one-time onboarding platform fee + monthly platform fee. We can amortize the one-time onboarding fee across the first 12 months or split across invoices (your choice)

3) Ramp to steady-state (month 4–12):
   - Stair-step increases at month 4 and month 7 to reach 100% steady-state commit
   - Discounting: tiered discounts apply as commits increase; we can surface a staircase pricing table in the attached sheet

4) Legal/commercial items:
   - Redwood can accept split payments (50/50) for the onboarding platform fee, and credits for evaluation will offset month-1 invoice once the PO is issued
   - We will provide a SOC 2 evidence list (attached) and a short responsibilities appendix for the SOW

I've CC'd Karthik for pricing validation and Marcus for commercial/contract redlines. If this high-level MAP looks aligned I'll push an updated MAP and the SOW for your procurement and legal teams.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Orchid_MAP_v2.xlsx, SOW-draft-20261015.pdf, SOC2-evidence-list.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lowe <emma@orchid-cloud.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment evaluation — MAP & payment approach

Emma / Priya — quick pricing note from our side to make the MAP actionable:

- Onboarding platform fee: $60k (one-time). Options: 100% upfront, or 50/50 split across the first two invoices, or amortize across 12 months at no interest for accounting purposes.
- Reserved commit pricing: we propose a staircase discount schedule: 0–30% commit => base rate; 31–70% => 12% discount; 71–100% => 18% discount. Exact $/GPU-hour numbers are in the attached MAP sheet.
- Credits: up to $25k evaluation credit applied to first invoiced commit as Priya mentioned.
- Minimum commitment term for reserved capacity: 12 months post-eval (standard for private deployments).

Also flagged: we can include a break-clause tied to SLA/latency/KPI checks at month 6 with reduced termination fee if KPIs are not met. Marcus, can you confirm legal is comfortable with a KPI exit clause?

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Sales Engineering
From: Emma Lowe <emma@orchid-cloud.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Chen <mchen@orchid-cloud.com>, Laura Diaz <laura.legal@orchid-cloud.com>, procurement@orchid-cloud.com
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 10:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment evaluation — MAP & payment approach

Thanks Priya/Karthik — this is helpful. Procurement/legal have three follow-ups before we pass to finance:

1) Can onboarding fee be amortized on Redwood side over 12 months with monthly billing to us (we prefer not to take a large upfront invoice)?
2) We need a sample amendment that shows the KPI exit clause language and the precise measurement windows for latency/accuracy.
3) SOC2 evidence: can you provide a filtered set of artifacts (e.g., architecture diagrams, logging retention policy) we can share internally — procurement asked for a short checklist rather than full reports initially.

If you can confirm (1)-(3) in writing and drop a redline-friendly SOW we will aim to issue a PO by Oct 29 conditional on redlines. Also, preference for signature via DocuSign; can Redwood prepare the envelope once SOW is final?

— Emma

Emma — quick responses inline and action items at the bottom.

1) Amortization: Yes — Redwood can own the amortization and invoice monthly over 12 months at the agreed platform fee total. We will reflect that as an invoice schedule in the MAP sheet and SOW. That removes the large one-time cash hit for Orchid.

2) KPI exit clause: Marcus will prepare a 2-paragraph amendment with objective measurement windows (30-day rolling window for latency, monthly eval for quality regressions, pass threshold at the stated KPIs). It will include a reduced termination charge (pro-rated onboarding fee) if KPIs are not met at month 6.

3) SOC 2 artifacts: attached is a curated SOC2-evidence-list.xlsx (redacted checklist) that procurement can use. Full reports will be made available under NDA if needed but initial checklist should suffice.

Action items: 
- Marcus: send draft amendment (2–3 business days) — cc'd
- Priya: update MAP to show amortized platform fee and sample invoice schedule (done same day)
- Karthik / Soojin: confirm the technical handoff and recommended monitoring probes for KPI measurement (Soojin, can you share the short tech appendix?)

We can also open a short 30-minute legal/finance sync this week if that helps close the questions quickly. Once procurement confirms, we will prepare a DocuSign envelope that includes the SOW and the amendment.

Thanks — Priya
